title: YouCoded brand — round 28: Mac Dock middle ground, menu bar sparkles

steps.surface: Mac Dock while a theme is on
steps.headline: Which middle ground for the Mac Dock?
steps.notice: B and C keep the theme's face but swap the white tile for see-through glass we draw. The Mac can't add real Liquid Glass to a swapped icon, so the glass is our drawing and won't move with the light. The face stays full colour in every look.

variants.label: A Never swap
variants.summary: As picked last round: the Mac's own glass icon, no theme face.

variants.label: B Clear glass
variants.summary: Theme face on see-through white glass.

variants.label: C Tinted glass
variants.summary: Theme face on glass faintly tinted with the theme's colour.

steps.headline: One-colour menu bar icon with the eye sparkles kept — good?
steps.changed: A small solid highlight sits inside each eye, so the cut-out face reads as friendly, not hollow.
steps.notice: Right: sparkles kept. Left: last round's, for comparison.
